name: ziomek.humanize-ai
description: Ziomek Humanize AI — gamepad-controlled avatar with TTS. Connect to a locally running ziomek server.

commands.title: Show Gamepad Debug Info
commands.description: Outputs current gamepad state and active mappings to the output channel.

commands.title: Show Gamepad Debug Window
commands.description: Opens an SDL window visualizing gamepad state in real-time.

commands.title: Show Ziomek — Avatar
commands.description: Shows the Ziomek avatar panel with animated single-frame portrait.

ziomek.enabled.description: Enable gamepad input for Ziomek Humanize AI

ziomek.tts.url.description: URL of the ziomek TTS server (default: localhost:5003)

ziomek.tts.port.description: Port for the ziomek TTS server

ziomek.tts.voice.description: Voice identifier for TTS (HuggingFace URL, local file, or catalog voice name)

ziomek.pollingIntervalMs.description: Gamepad polling interval in milliseconds (lower = more responsive, higher CPU usage)

ziomek.debounceMs.description: Minimum time between repeated actions in milliseconds (prevents rapid duplicates)
